subject: Mathematics
prompt: Slope of line joining (x₁,y₁) and (x₂,y₂)?
explain: Slope = rise/run = difference of ordinates over difference of abscissas.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Angle θ between two lines with slopes m₁ and m₂?
explain: Acute angle between two lines: tan θ = |(m₁−m₂)/(1+m₁m₂)|.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Condition for two lines with slopes m₁, m₂ to be parallel?
explain: Parallel lines have equal slopes; distinct intercepts ensure they don't coincide.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Condition for two lines with slopes m₁, m₂ to be perpendicular?
explain: Two lines are perpendicular iff product of their slopes equals −1.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Distance from point (x₁,y₁) to line ax+by+c = 0?
explain: Perpendicular distance formula: |ax₁+by₁+c| divided by √(a²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of line in slope-intercept form?
explain: y = mx + c: m is slope, c is y-intercept.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of line in intercept form with x-intercept a, y-intercept b?
explain: Intercept form: line cuts x-axis at a and y-axis at b, giving x/a + y/b = 1.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of line through (x₁,y₁) with slope m?
explain: Point-slope form: line with slope m passing through a given point.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Normal form of straight line: p = distance from origin, α = inclination of normal?
explain: Normal (perpendicular) form: x cosα + y sinα = p, p > 0.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Distance between parallel lines ax+by+c₁=0 and ax+by+c₂=0?
explain: For parallel lines with same a, b coefficients, distance = |c₁−c₂|/√(a²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Foot of perpendicular from (x₁,y₁) to line ax+by+c=0: parameter r = ?
explain: Foot: (x₁+ar, y₁+br) where r = −(ax₁+by₁+c)/(a²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Area of triangle with vertices (x₁,y₁),(x₂,y₂),(x₃,y₃)?
explain: Area by coordinate formula = ½|Σxᵢ(yᵢ₊₁−yᵢ₋₁)|.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Collinearity condition for three points using area?
explain: Three points are collinear iff the triangle they form has zero area.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Slope of x-axis (horizontal line)?
explain: Horizontal lines make 0° with x-axis, so slope = tan 0° = 0.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Slope of y-axis (vertical line)?
explain: Vertical lines make 90° with x-axis; tan 90° is undefined, so slope is undefined.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of a line through origin with slope m?
explain: Line through origin has c = 0 in y = mx + c, giving y = mx.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Point of intersection of lines a₁x+b₁y+c₁=0 and a₂x+b₂y+c₂=0 exists when?
explain: Lines intersect (not parallel) iff the determinant of coefficients ≠ 0.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Image (reflection) of point (x₁,y₁) in line ax+by+c=0: shift factor?
explain: Image = (x₁+a·t, y₁+b·t) where t = −2(ax₁+by₁+c)/(a²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Condition for three lines to be concurrent?
explain: Three lines are concurrent iff the 3×3 determinant of their coefficients = 0.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of angle bisectors of lines a₁x+b₁y+c₁=0 and a₂x+b₂y+c₂=0?
explain: Angle bisector locus: equal perpendicular distances from both lines.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Line ax+by+c=0 in slope-intercept form: slope = ?
explain: Rewriting: y = (−a/b)x − c/b, so slope = −a/b.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of family of lines through intersection of L₁=0 and L₂=0?
explain: Any line through intersection of L₁=0 and L₂=0 is L₁ + λL₂ = 0 for some λ.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Inclination angle α of a line with slope m satisfies?
explain: Inclination α is measured from positive x-axis anticlockwise; α ∈ [0°,180°).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Locus of a point equidistant from two fixed points is?
explain: Set of points equidistant from two points forms the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining them.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: If ax+by+c=0 passes through origin, then?
explain: Substituting (0,0): a(0)+b(0)+c = 0 ⟹ c = 0.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: x-intercept of line ax+by+c=0 is?
explain: Set y=0: ax+c=0 → x = -c/a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: y-intercept of line ax+by+c=0 is?
explain: Set x=0: by+c=0 → y = -c/b.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of vertical line through (h, k)?
explain: A vertical line has constant x-coordinate for all points on it.

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Acute angle bisector is chosen when a₁a₂+b₁b₂ is?

prompt: Line through (x₁,y₁) at inclination α in parametric form: point at distance r?

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Midpoint of segment joining (x₁,y₁) and (x₂,y₂)?

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Section formula: point dividing (x₁,y₁)(x₂,y₂) in ratio m:n internally?

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Centroid of triangle with vertices (x₁,y₁),(x₂,y₂),(x₃,y₃)?
explain: Centroid = simple average of x-coordinates and y-coordinates separately.

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Number of lines through a point with integer slope parallel to x-axis?

subject: Mathematics
prompt: If P divides (x₁,y₁)(x₂,y₂) externally in ratio m:n, x-coordinate is?
